The clinical guidelines retrieved do not mention semaglutide as a treatment for autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The only result returned pertains to sepsis management [Surviving Sepsis Campaign, 2021], which is unrelated to ASD. 

**Conclusion:**  
There is no evidence in indexed clinical guidelines supporting the use of semaglutide for ASD. Semaglutide is approved for type 2 diabetes and obesity, but its efficacy or safety for ASD has not been evaluated in guideline-developing studies. Always consult a healthcare provider for individualized care.
